fragments.text: Setting: Dawn over Nyas. The balloon rests at the western aerodrome. At River Gate, Sela watches a clean, restricted stream enter the Low Basin main. Beside the distribution queue, yesterday's surrender notice curls in the damp. Narration: “THE MORNING AFTER THE SURRENDER.”

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Inside the signal room, Orin pins acknowledgments beside a map. Several districts remain blank. A Zoran officer reads a message aloud. (OFFICER: “EASTERN ARTILLERY REFUSES TO SURRENDER ITS GUNS. TWO FRONTIER COMMANDS HAVE NOT ANSWERED.”) (GEROFF: “BRING ME THE ORIGINAL MESSAGE.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Midori stands by the window. Beyond her, a stretcher passes the water queue. (MIDORI: “I COULD REACH THE BATTERIES BEFORE NOON.”) Setting: Buren, his injured arm still supported, sets a chair beside the map. (BUREN: “THEN SIT HERE UNTIL WE KNOW WHAT YOU WOULD FIND.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Geroff separates the reports. (GEROFF: “ONE REFUSAL. TWO SILENCES. WE WILL NOT TURN THEM INTO THREE BATTLES.” -> “SEND MESSENGERS. BRING THE UNIT RECORDS AND OFFICERS WHO KNOW THESE COMMANDERS.”) Setting: Midori sits, reluctantly.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: In a guarded room nearby, M'ow Oh hears the request. He looks at the empty place where his command seal once lay. (M'OW OH: “BRING THE EASTERN COLONEL'S LAST ACKNOWLEDGMENT. HE ALWAYS CHANGES ONE WORD WHEN HE IS AFRAID.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: M'ow Oh enters the signal room under escort. A Zoran officer moves to exclude him from the map. Geroff stops the officer. (GEROFF: “HE IS UNDER INVESTIGATION. HE IS ALSO THE MAN THOSE SOLDIERS RECOGNIZE. BOTH FACTS APPLY.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: M'ow Oh reads the artillery message. (M'OW OH: “HIS MEN HEARD THAT SURRENDER MEANS EXECUTION. HE HAS PUT THE GUNS ACROSS THE ROAD BECAUSE THEIR FAMILIES ARE BEHIND THEM.”)
(BUREN: “THAT DOES NOT MAKE THE ROAD HIS.”) (M'OW OH: “NO. IT TELLS US WHAT HE MUST HEAR BEFORE HE OPENS IT.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: May Jin prepares parallel texts: Zoran geometric glyphs run left to right; Nyssarian engineered pictographs run top to bottom in columns ordered right to left. Each uses its own numeral symbols. Geroff specifies the Zoran requirements: cease fire, admit a witnessed inspection, secure ammunition, and leave the relief route open. M'ow Oh records the order in his own voice, including the old unit-response phrase.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: A Nyssarian liaison questions the unsealed order. M'ow Oh points to the custody entry. (M'OW OH: “I SURRENDERED THE SEAL. THE WITNESSES CAN CONFIRM THAT THIS IS MY ORDER. I WILL NOT BORROW IT BACK IN SECRET.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Midori volunteers to accompany the messengers. Geroff allows her to escort the relief convoy, not to lead the negotiation. (MIDORI: “AND IF THEY FIRE?”) (BUREN: “PROTECT THE PEOPLE. GIVE US TIME TO ANSWER.”) Setting: She repeats the instruction before leaving.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The convoy reaches the eastern road. Nyssarian guns overlook the approach; families shelter behind the emplacement. Midori walks beside a cart marked for medical relief in the established world script. Buren accompanies the convoy in a relief cart, his injured arm supported. She keeps her hands visible and her protective shield close.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The battery commander refuses to leave cover. (COMMANDER: “THEY WILL TAKE THE GUNS AND THEN TAKE US.”) Setting: May Jin reads the guarantees and their limits. (MAY JIN: “INSPECTION AND CUSTODY. NO PROMISE THAT EVERY OFFICER IS INNOCENT. NO PERMISSION TO PUNISH YOUR FAMILIES.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: A frightened gunner begins traversing a barrel toward the convoy. Midori raises a wind barrier between the muzzle and the carts. She does not strike the emplacement. Behind her, a healer leads the civilians out of the line of fire.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The recorded voice of M'ow Oh reaches the battery. The commander answers the authentication phrase. Then Geroff's written terms are carried forward by a Nyssarian lieutenant and a Zoran officer together. The commander lowers his binoculars.

(M'OW OH: “THEN ORDERS MUST COME THROUGH PEOPLE MY COUNTRY WILL HEAR. IF EVERY NOTICE BEARS ONLY YOUR SEAL, RESISTANCE WILL RECRUIT FROM THE WATER QUEUES.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Orin sets the civilian ledger between them. (ORIN: “AND IF EVERY NOTICE BEARS ONLY YOURS, THOSE QUEUES WILL EXPECT ANOTHER REQUISITION FOR THE ARMY.”)
Setting: M'ow Oh accepts the rebuke. (M'OW OH: “THEN LET THEM SEE WHO AGREED, WHAT IT COSTS, AND WHO MAY CHALLENGE IT.”)

(M'OW OH: “WRITE THAT WE SURRENDERED. WRITE WHY. I WILL NOT ASK YOU TO HIDE IT SO MY PORTRAIT CAN REMAIN ON A WALL.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Midori waits outside with her own written account. A wounded Nyssarian woman recognizes her and turns away. Midori does not ask the woman to stay. She enters when called.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (MIDORI: “WHEN THEY TRIED TO TAKE RAUK, I RAISED A FIELD AROUND THEM. THE SHELTER ENTRANCE WAS INSIDE IT.”)
Setting: Hanae supplies the injury record. Midori corrects an entry that calls the event a controlled defense. (MIDORI: “I STOPPED IT. THAT DOES NOT MEAN I CONTROLLED IT FROM THE BEGINNING.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (ZORAN OBSERVER: “YOU ARE GIVING THEM A WEAPON AGAINST HER.”) Setting: Geroff closes the door against the waiting crowd, allowing the testimony to continue. (GEROFF: “THEN WE HAD BETTER MAKE THE RECORD ACCURATE.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Midori signs. No verdict is announced. She agrees to answer further questions and remain contactable through the transition office. Outside, the woman who turned away has left. Midori folds her copy and carries it with her.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: At the transition table, a bereaved Zoran councilor objects to shipping more crystals into Nyas. (COUNCILOR: “MY SON DIED TAKING A POSITION FROM THOSE PEOPLE. NOW WE ARE SUPPLYING IT.”) Setting: On the table, the former position is marked as a field hospital.

fragments.text: Setting: M'ow Oh begins to answer, then stops. (M'OW OH: “YOUR SON. WHAT WAS HIS NAME?”) Setting: The councilor answers quietly, his voice breaking; the words are not lettered. M'ow Oh listens, then bows his head.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Later, the councilor walks through the hospital beside Hanae. He sees a Zoran patient and a Nyssarian patient waiting for the same sterilizer. He checks its crystal connection. His grief does not disappear.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Back at the table, he signs the inspection entry without endorsing the larger settlement. (COUNCILOR: “SEND THE HOSPITAL CRYSTALS. I WANT THE NEXT ACCOUNT AS WELL.”) Setting: Hanae takes the authorized supplies and returns to work.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: At River Gate, Sela brings an inspected empty crystal for the next scheduled recharge. Before connection, Midori steadies herself against the bench. Her fingers tremble; Sela keeps the charging switch open.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

Vey looks at her eyes in the glass of an inspection plate. A thin red ring is already visible around the orange. Vey holds up a hand to stop the connection.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (VEY: “HANAE. BEFORE WE CONNECT HER.”) (MIDORI: “I AM TIRED. I AM NOT EMPTY.”) (HANAE: “THAT IS WHAT I AM CHECKING.”) Setting: She examines Midori while the Zoran healer compares the readings with the earlier ledger. (HEALER: “YOUR RESERVE HAS FALLEN. THE AMOUNT STILL INSIDE YOU IS TOO MUCH TO KEEP SAFELY.”) Setting: No additional mana has entered Midori; the warning precedes this session's discharge.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The red briefly fills Midori's irises. Her fingers tremble. She tries to form a small light; it flares much larger than intended. Vey isolates the equipment before the surge reaches a damaged conduit.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (HANAE: “NO MORE PRETENDING THAT HOLDING IT IS HARMLESS. WE NEED A CONTROLLED DISCHARGE BEFORE IT INJURES YOU.”) Setting: Midori looks toward the water queue. (MIDORI: “THEN FIND SOMETHING USEFUL TO PUT IT IN.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Vey rejects a row of cracked utility crystals. (WORKER: “THOSE ARE THE CRYSTALS THE PUMPS NEED.”) (VEY: “NEED DOES NOT MAKE A FRACTURED VESSEL SAFE.”) Setting: He selects sound reserve crystals already inspected for the municipal bank.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Sela and Zoran crystal keepers prepare conditioned connections, isolation switches, and spare receiving capacity. Hanae sets rest intervals. The city cannot accept a single violent release; Midori cannot safely keep the excess indefinitely.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Midori sits within the charging station. A red reflection crosses Sela's face as Midori looks up. (MIDORI: “IF I TELL YOU I CAN DO ANOTHER, CHECK BEFORE YOU BELIEVE ME.”) Setting: Sela rests her hand on the cutoff. (SELA: “I WAS GOING TO.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The first receiving crystal brightens. Vey regulates the flow rather than seeking speed. A healer monitors Midori's condition while another worker carries the charged crystal to an isolated rack. The next empty unit is connected only after the first is secure.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (MESSENGER AT THE DOOR: “WHEN CAN SHE COME TO THE HOSPITAL?”) Setting: Sela points to the municipal reserve docket. (SELA: “THESE WILL GO THERE. SHE STAYS HERE UNTIL HANAE SAYS OTHERWISE.”) Setting: For once, Midori does not argue.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Successive charging sessions pass with food, water, and enforced rests between them. Show the same seated Midori at separate moments, not an uninterrupted torrent. The red retreats unevenly from her eyes.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: During a pause, Midori apologizes for making relief depend on her condition. Vey checks the next crystal. (VEY: “YOUR CONDITION WAS ALWAYS PART OF THE SYSTEM. LEAVING IT OUT OF THE LEDGER DID NOT REMOVE IT.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The final safe session ends. Hanae checks Midori's eyes and pulse. Her irises have returned to orange. (HANAE: “BELOW THE IMMEDIATE DANGER. YOU STILL CARRY MANA. WE ARE STOPPING HERE, NOT DECLARING YOU INEXHAUSTIBLE.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Sela enters each charged crystal into the city's reserve inventory. She records each destination and the observed transfer losses. The healer adds Midori's reduced reserve reading beside the earlier measurement.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: From the window, Midori watches a cart take the reserve crystals to North Hospital. She remains seated while the workers leave without her. A small smile comes before she notices she is smiling.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: May Jin arrives at the civilian review office with Zoran military papers. A clerk recognizes the service entry and places it beside the collaborator accusation. (CLERK: “YOU ACCEPTED THEIR POSITION.”) (MAY JIN: “YES.”) Setting: He leaves the service papers on the desk.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (REVIEWER: “WHAT DID YOU TRANSLATE? WHAT MILITARY INFORMATION DID YOU GIVE THEM? WHICH WORK DID YOU CHOOSE?”) Setting: May Jin supplies his records. (MAY JIN: “CHECK EACH ASSIGNMENT AGAINST THE ORIGINALS. HEAR THE PEOPLE WHO WERE THERE.”) Setting: The reviewer opens a new evidence file.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (NEIGHBOR: “HE STILL WORKS FOR THEIR ARMY.”) Setting: May Jin hears it.
(LIAN: “WILL YOU RETURN TO THEIR CAMP EVERY EVENING? WHERE ARE WE SUPPOSED TO BELONG IN THAT LIFE?”) Setting: He looks down at his service papers.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: At their temporary room, the younger child places an empty bowl where the older child should sit. Lian pushes the empty bowl beside his place. (LIAN: “WE ARE HERE. THE MISSING ARE OURS. DECIDE WHERE YOU ARE TRYING TO COME HOME.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: May Jin unfolds the search board's latest contradictory entries. He places his military papers beside them, then begins a request for release from service.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: May Jin gives his request to the Zoran commander who authorized his escort. (MAY JIN: “I ACCEPTED THE WORK. I AM ASKING TO END IT PROPERLY. I NEED TO FIND MY FAMILY AND LIVE HERE WITHOUT CARRYING YOUR ORDERS IN MY POCKET.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (COMMANDER: “WE STILL NEED INTERPRETERS.”) (MAY JIN: “I WILL FINISH THE HANDOVER AND TEACH THE REPLACEMENTS WHAT THEY NEED.” -> “BEING NEEDED CANNOT MEAN I NEVER GET TO LEAVE.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Geroff reviews the request with the service and parole records. Any surviving parole restrictions must be formally resolved alongside the military release. He refuses an officer's suggestion that May Jin be retained until every peace negotiation is finished.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (GEROFF: “YOU MAY VOLUNTEER FOR CIVILIAN INTERPRETATION AFTERWARD. THAT WILL BE A NEW ARRANGEMENT. IT WILL NOT BE AN OBLIGATION HIDDEN INSIDE YOUR RELEASE.”) (MAY JIN: “PUT THAT IN THE RELEASE.”) Setting: Geroff addresses the clerk. (GEROFF: “INCLUDE IT.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: May Jin returns to Lian with a handover date, not an immediate declaration of freedom. She reads the document twice. (LIAN: “GOOD. NOW TELL ME WHAT THE RAILWAY OFFICE FOUND.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Orin and May Jin compare original transfer sheets with copied shelter lists. The same wagon number appears under two destinations. A station clerk recognizes a changed routing mark: the wagon was diverted when a bridge closed.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The older child's entry belongs to that wagon, but the grandparents' records do not. May Jin begins to combine them out of hope. Orin stops his hand. (ORIN: “WE FOLLOW THE ENTRIES SEPARATELY UNTIL THEY MEET. WE CANNOT FIND THEM BY MAKING THEM AGREE.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: A Zoran refugee register records two elderly Nyssarians treated at a road clinic. Their ages and names fit his parents, but the identifying information is incomplete. Hanae writes a medical inquiry and hands it to the courier.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Two inquiries leave by established courier routes, one toward the clinic and one toward the redirected evacuation station. May Jin watches them go, then returns to translating another family's list while he waits.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Narration: “OVER THE FOLLOWING DAYS.” Setting: Joint messengers deliver surrender confirmations, clinic returns, and refugee lists in the same battered satchels. The messengers travel through the reopened road checkpoints.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: At the clinic, May Jin identifies his parents in person. His father is recovering from illness; his mother grips his sleeve so tightly he cannot bow. Neither knew where Lian or the children had been taken.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (MAY JIN: “LIAN AND THE LITTLE ONE ARE SAFE. WE HAVE A ROUTE TO FOLLOW FOR THE OLDER ONE.”) Setting: His father sees the Zoran escort outside and stiffens. (MAY JIN: “THEY BROUGHT THE MESSAGE THROUGH. I WILL EXPLAIN THE REST WHEN YOU ARE STRONG ENOUGH TO ARGUE.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: At the evacuation station, Lian identifies the older child among displaced school groups. (OLDER CHILD: “WILL THEY TAKE US AWAY FROM EACH OTHER AGAIN?”) Setting: Lian kneels and opens her arms, letting the child approach before they turn toward the escort.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: On their return, the family meets at the search office. The younger child runs between the adults toward the older sibling. May Jin and Lian hold each other after both children are within reach. Orin quietly removes the missing markers, keeping the records.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The reunited family shares a cramped meal. (FATHER: “YOU TOOK A PLACE IN THEIR MILITARY?”)
(MAY JIN: “AFTER CAPTURE AND PAROLE, YES. I CHOSE THE INTERPRETER'S WORK. I HAVE ASKED TO LEAVE IT. I AM COMPLETING THE HANDOVER.”) Setting: His father studies him across the table.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (MOTHER: “CAN WE STAY TOGETHER NOW?”) Setting: May Jin shows the housing application and release timetable. (MAY JIN: “THE LODGING IS TEMPORARY. WE CAN APPLY TOGETHER. MY RELEASE IS DUE AFTER THE HANDOVER.”) Setting: She puts a hand over the family names on the form.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: At the civilian review, verified translation records and witnesses narrow the allegations. The panel records its findings on the acts examined and withdraws the unsupported collaborator charges. The decision is public; it cannot order neighbors to trust him.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: After the handover, the Zoran commander signs the service release and closure of remaining parole restrictions. May Jin returns his military authorization. He retains his copy of the record so his history cannot be rewritten as either secret treason or effortless heroism.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Lian waits outside with the children. (MAY JIN: “I AM GOING HOME.”) (LIAN: “THEN WALK WITH US.”) Setting: Later civilian translation remains his choice; today he goes with his family.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Vey gathers Zoran crystal keepers and Nyssarian operators beside the two working utility walkers. (VEY: “WE HAVE PROVED THAT IT CAN WORK. WE HAVE NOT PROVED THAT THE NEXT WORKSHOP CAN MAKE ONE SAFELY.”) Setting: A repaired regulator lies beside an unstable imitation.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: A Zoran keeper supplies a sound crystal. A Nyssarian fitter adjusts the interface while Sela checks the load. Each corrects something the other would have missed. Midori sits outside the power circuit, observing.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The prototype adapter drives a pump under a steady load, then falters when the load changes. Vey cuts it off. No one calls a brief successful run a complete solution.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Sela points to the flooded pipe gallery. (SELA: “THE CITY WILL NOT PROMISE TO DRAW THE SAME AMOUNT EVERY MOMENT. MAKE THE REGULATOR EXPECT OUR MISTAKES AS WELL AS OUR BEST DAY.”) Setting: The keeper and fitter return to the bench together.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: A Zoran crystal feeds the Nyssarian equipment. The load changes; the regulator holds. Midori instinctively lifts her hand when a gauge jumps. Vey reminds her that intervening would invalidate the test and could worsen a fault. She lowers it.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The operator deliberately isolates a simulated failed branch. The remaining circuit stays stable. A second operator repeats the procedure from the written instructions rather than memory of Vey's demonstration.

fragments.text: Setting: Hanae authorizes the next supervised stage. A sterilizer completes its cycle. The instruments are checked independently before the equipment is released for medical use.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Midori waits for someone to ask for her mana. Instead, the operator requests the next scheduled supply crystal. She looks down at her empty hands, then helps carry a tray that requires no magic.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: At the transition table, Geroff reviews a limited shipment of Zoran crystals and replacement couplers. M'ow Oh identifies Nyssarian workshops able to repair housings and manufacture compatible fittings. Orin supplies district needs rather than military priorities.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (ZORAN OFFICIAL: “WHAT STOPS THESE CRYSTALS POWERING WEAPONS?”) (VEY: “RECORDED CIVILIAN INSTALLATIONS. ISOLATED CIRCUITS. INSPECTIONS YOU CAN ATTEND.”) Setting: He lays the wiring plan beside the custody register.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Sela refuses a plan that leaves every repair dependent on a specialist arriving from Zora. Apprentices and operators from both peoples are assigned training places. The agreement includes parts, instruction, and recorded maintenance responsibilities.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Geroff signs within his relief mandate; longer supply and trade terms go forward for the required ratification. M'ow Oh gives the implementing orders under witnessed supervision. The assembly posts the allocations.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: In Old Market, a coupler made by a second workshop powers a district pump. The queue moves. Midori is across the street buying food with May Jin's family when it starts. She hears the motor and turns, pleasantly startled.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The assembly meets with representatives of reopened districts. (FIRST DELEGATE: “WE WANT FEWER ZORAN GUARDS.”) (SECOND DELEGATE: “NOT UNTIL THE HARDLINERS ARE GONE.”) Setting: Orin enters both demands in the public record.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Geroff and M'ow Oh negotiate withdrawal and weapons inspections with the affected commanders. Separate working groups keep open files on disputed territory, prisoner returns, and civilian claims.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The bereaved councilor marks a relief clause. (COUNCILOR: “THIS GRANTS THE HOSPITAL UNLIMITED REQUISITIONS.”) (HANAE: “THEN LIMIT IT TO VERIFIED PATIENT NEED AND REQUIRE A PUBLIC ACCOUNT.”) Setting: They revise the clause together; the remaining objections stay on the agenda.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (MIDORI: “WHO DECIDES IN AN EMERGENCY IF I AM NOT HERE?”)
Setting: Sela points to the posted duty roster; Hanae points to the hospital reserve account. (VEY: “WE WILL DISAGREE. THEN THE PEOPLE WHOSE TURN IT IS WILL DECIDE.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: That evening Midori leaves the distribution station before its shift ends. The pumps keep running. She pauses outside, listening until Sela calls through the window: (SELA: “GO AND EAT. WE KNOW HOW TO CLOSE A VALVE.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: In the surrendered research inventory, a clerk reaches the portal entry Kesh tried to trade for her escape. Midori stops at the description. (GEROFF: “CAN IT MOVE TROOPS?”) Setting: The accompanying records cannot answer without inspection.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: M'ow Oh identifies the research complex and its senior scientist. He gives the location and access procedures from custody. (M'OW OH: “THE STAFF MUST KNOW THAT THE RESEARCH IS BEING EXAMINED, NOT CONFISCATED BY A RIVAL BUREAU.”) Setting: Geroff requires guards and civilian technical witnesses.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: May Jin arrives as a civilian interpreter under a new, limited agreement. He has chosen this assignment after discussing it with Lian. Geroff checks the new authorization rather than handing him his old military papers.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Midori walks with Vey through a repaired district toward the complex. (MIDORI: “WHEN KESH OFFERED IT, I THOUGHT I WOULD OWE HER MY WAY HOME.”) (VEY: “SHE OFFERED SOMEONE ELSE'S WORK. LET US ASK THE PEOPLE WHO DID IT WHAT THEY ACTUALLY HAVE.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The research doors open onto a vast circular apparatus, disconnected from its former supply. The senior scientist waits beside the controls, exhausted and defensive. (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “BEFORE ANYONE TOUCHES THAT SWITCH, I NEED TO KNOW WHO INTENDS TO LISTEN.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The scientist lays out preserved research diagrams. (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “IT FOLLOWS THE TRAVELER'S LINK TO THE WORLD OF ORIGIN. WE CANNOT CHOOSE A DESTINATION AND SEND AN ARMY THERE.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (GEROFF: “WHERE WOULD IT TAKE SOMEONE BORN HERE?”)

(SENIOR SCIENTIST: “OUR RESULTS GIVE US NO ROUTE OUT OF THIS WORLD FOR SOMEONE WHO ORIGINATES HERE. THE SAME LIMITATION APPLIES TO US. A DESTINATION DIAL WOULD BE MORE CONVENIENT. WE HAVE NEVER MADE ONE.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (MIDORI: “I WAS BORN ON EARTH.”) Setting: The scientist stops turning the pages. (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “THEN YOU ARE THE CASE WE COULD NEVER INVESTIGATE. SOMEONE HERE WHOSE ORIGIN LIES ELSEWHERE.”)
Setting: He raises an instrument. (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “MAY I MEASURE THE RESPONSE?”) Setting: Midori nods.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Geroff questions the researchers about military transport and ordinary trade. Their answers establish neither capability. He closes his requisition folder. (GEROFF: “THEN ZORA HAS NO USE FOR IT AS A PASSAGE. KEEP THE DANGEROUS EQUIPMENT SECURE. THE RESEARCH NEED NOT BECOME A TROPHY.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The researchers begin talking at once about Midori's origin, her arrival, and what can be measured. She stiffens under their excitement. (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “ONE QUESTION AT A TIME. AND SHE MAY REFUSE EVERY ONE OF THEM.”) Setting: The room quiets.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (MIDORI: “WHAT CAN YOU TELL ME ABOUT EARTH?”) (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “YOUR ORIGIN MAY SUPPLY THE DESTINATION. THAT DOES NOT GIVE US AN ADDRESS, A DATE, OR PROOF OF SAFE ARRIVAL.”) Setting: He turns the unverified portion of the diagram toward her.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (MIDORI: “AND IF I STAY HERE?”) Setting: The scientist looks at the dormant ring. (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “THEN WE KEEP A QUESTION UNANSWERED. THAT HAS HAPPENED BEFORE.”) Setting: A younger researcher lowers a page titled with Midori's name in the established script.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “WHAT DO YOU REMEMBER OF ARRIVING? THE JOURNEY, YOUR BODY, THE LANGUAGE?”) (MIDORI: “I CAN TELL YOU WHAT I EXPERIENCED. SOME OF THE EXPLANATION CAME FROM ZORNA. MARK THAT SEPARATELY.”) Setting: May Jin divides the notes accordingly in both languages.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: A technician offers her a chair and adjusts the instruments so she need not stand inside the ring. These are small acts, but Midori notices the absence of guards positioning her as an object to be handled.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: She agrees to preliminary measurements. (MIDORI: “IF I SAY STOP, YOU STOP.”) (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “YES.”) Setting: He places the cutoff control within her reach. Midori tests it; the instruments go dark. He waits for her nod before resetting them for the first measurement.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: In a quiet research room, Midori opens her account. (MIDORI: “I MET ZORNA IN THE DOTG. I SPOKE WITH HER THERE.”) Setting: The illustrated recollections show only her experienced meetings and what she remembers being told. Keep recollections within her experienced viewpoint.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The Nyssarian researchers compare her account with their records concerning Nyssara. An assumption about solitary invention is crossed out. (RESEARCHER: “WE THOUGHT THIS KNOWLEDGE HAD ONE SOURCE. YOUR ACCOUNT LEAVES US WITH ANOTHER SOURCE ACTING ON THE SAME HISTORY.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (MIDORI: “I REMEMBER ROSELYN, AND A HISTORY IN WHICH SHE WAS NEVER BORN. I REMEMBER ASHIRE ALIVE, AND DEAD FOR YURS BEFORE I ARRIVED.”)
(MAY JIN: “DOES ANYONE ELSE REMEMBER BOTH?”) (MIDORI: “NOT AS I DO. DO NOT PUT WORDS IN THEIR MOUTHS BECAUSE I REMEMBER THEM.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Vey brings authenticated copies of contradictory inscriptions preserved in crystal-shielded storage. These are physical records, not a second person's memories of the discarded history. The scientists mark which claims the records can support and which they cannot.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Midori watches separate pieces begin to fit: Zorna, Nyssara, the research, and her own arrival. (MIDORI: “YOU HAVE BEEN TRYING TO EXPLAIN THIS TOO.”) (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “FOR LONGER THAN WE UNDERSTOOD WHAT THE QUESTION WAS.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The research board now shows two columns, Zorna and Nyssara, with dated or relatively ordered evidence where available. Gaps remain visible. No mortal record supplies a complete view of the gods' motives.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (FIRST RESEARCHER: “THEY MAY HAVE WORKED TOGETHER.”) (SECOND RESEARCHER: “BUT THEIR ACTIONS OPPOSED EACH OTHER.”)
(RESEARCHER: “OPPOSING MOVES DO NOT PROVE SEPARATE PURPOSES. WE CANNOT ESTABLISH THE PURPOSE FROM THE MOVES ALONE.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Midori thinks of the impossible coincidences in her life. (MIDORI: “YOU THINK THEY MAY HAVE WORKED TOGETHER. ON US.”) Setting: The scientist answers carefully. (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “THAT IS OUR THEORY. NOT PROOF OF WHAT THEY WANTED.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (MAY JIN: “DOES THAT CHANGE WHAT THE TARGETING LOGS SAY?”) Setting: Midori looks at her copy of the inquiry statement. (MIDORI: “NO. IT DOES NOT MAKE MY CHOICES SOMEONE ELSE'S. IT DOES MEAN WE SHOULD STOP ACCEPTING EVERY DIVINE EXPLANATION WITHOUT QUESTIONS.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: They preserve the evidence, leaving question marks beside the gods' purpose on the board. (MIDORI: “MAY I TAKE COPIES TO SERAPHINE?”) Setting: A researcher prepares duplicate records.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Portal tests proceed without a person crossing. Engineers check the aperture's stability, shutdown controls, and isolated power storage. They record failures as carefully as successes. Midori is present for the explanation, not required as the load for every test.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: A researcher apologizes that so much equipment has been spent on a machine that cannot save the city's water supply. Midori looks at the repaired coupler powering the test bench. (MIDORI: “THE PEOPLE WORKING ON THIS HELPED MAKE THOSE REGULATORS TOO.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The scientist shows her a revised measurement that strengthens the world-of-origin theory. His excitement is unmistakable. (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “YOU MIGHT ACTUALLY REACH IT.”) Setting: Then, before she mistakes hope for certainty: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “MIGHT. WE HAVE NOT SENT YOU.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (MIDORI: “WHAT DO YOU WANT IN EXCHANGE?”) Setting: The scientist gestures toward the instruments. (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “YOUR PERMISSION TO LEARN. YOUR HONEST ANSWERS. IF YOU CHOOSE TO CROSS, YOUR INFORMED AGREEMENT. NOT A PARDON FOR THE GOVERNMENT.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Outside, Midori looks back through the research doors. (MIDORI: “THE PEOPLE I WANTED TO DESTROY ARE TRYING TO GIVE ME A ROAD HOME.”) (SELA: “SOME OF US ARE. YOU ARE ALLOWED TO KNOW WHICH PEOPLE YOU ARE SPEAKING TO.”) Setting: Midori's gaze stays on the research room.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: During a low-power examination, the instrument tracking Midori's stored mana produces an unstable trace near the inactive aperture. The scientist stops before activation. He leaves the activation switch open and marks the unstable trace.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: He explains the crossing restriction. (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “A STORED MANA LOAD WOULD ENTER THE TRANSFER WITH YOU. WE CANNOT PERMIT THAT. BEFORE YOU STEP THROUGH, YOU MUST DISCHARGE ALL OF IT. ALL, MIDORI. NOT MERELY ENOUGH TO BRING YOU BELOW RED.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (MIDORI: “THEN HOW DO YOU POWER IT?”) Setting: Vey separates the connections on the diagram. (VEY: “YOU CHARGE THE PORTAL'S ISOLATED SUPPLY BEFORE CROSSING. IT OPERATES FROM THAT STORE AFTER WE DISCONNECT YOU. THE POWER FOR THE MACHINE DOES NOT TRAVEL INSIDE YOU.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The remaining stored mana can be conditioned into the city's inspected reserve banks. Their existing grid is now powered through compatible Zoran crystals and trained crews; this contribution will be a reserve, not a substitute for sustainable supply.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Midori looks from the portal store to the municipal bank allocation. (MIDORI: “SOME TO OPEN THE WAY. THE REST STAYS HERE.”) (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “AND NONE CROSSES INSIDE YOU.”)
(MIDORI: “WHAT WILL EMPTY FEEL LIKE?”) Setting: The scientist calls Hanae to the room.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Hanae and the Zoran healer examine the proposed discharge. They distinguish Midori's stored mana from her ordinary biological life. The healer marks her life signs separately from the mana trace. (ZORAN HEALER: “THIS IS HER STORED MANA. THIS IS HER LIVING BODY. WE MUST EMPTY ONE WITHOUT HARMING THE OTHER.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (HANAE: “WE STOP IF THE PROCEDURE HARMS YOU. WE ALSO STOP THE CROSSING IF YOU STILL HOLD A RESERVE. THE SCHEDULE DOES NOT OUTRANK EITHER CONDITION.”)
(MIDORI: “COULD I HEAL MYSELF AFTERWARD?”) (ZORAN HEALER: “YOU WILL HAVE NO STORED MANA TO USE.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Midori thinks of all the times power answered fear before thought did. (MIDORI: “NO SHIELD. NO HEALING. NO FLIGHT.”) Setting: Hanae gives her a cup of water. (HANAE: “THEN DRINK THIS BEFORE IT BECOMES ANOTHER THING YOU MEAN TO DO WITH MAGIC.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Vey writes the sequence: test and stabilize; allocate the necessary portal power; condition the remaining reserve into municipal crystals; disconnect; independently confirm no internal reserve; cross while the externally powered aperture is available. There is no last instant magical refill.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Midori studies the sequence. (MIDORI: “IF I CHANGE MY MIND AFTER THE DISCHARGE?”)
(SENIOR SCIENTIST: “YOU REMAIN HERE WITHOUT THAT STORED RESERVE. THE CITY KEEPS ITS POWER. YOUR PERMISSION IS NOT A SWITCH THAT LOCKS BEHIND YOU.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: A later transition session reviews inspected withdrawals, prisoner exchanges, missing-person work, and the civilian power agreement. Worn registers and changed district maps cover the table.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (GEROFF: “THE LONGER-TERM PROPOSALS HAVE GONE TO THE COUNCIL FOR RATIFICATION. RELIEF AND SURRENDER COMPLIANCE CONTINUE UNDER OUR PRESENT MANDATE.”) Setting: The Nyssarian civilian representatives enter their approvals and objections beside the proposed terms.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: M'ow Oh answers questions about the remaining military records under supervision. He has not regained unrestricted office. His authority helps secure compliance while testimony and command responsibility continue to be examined.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (MIDORI: “I MAY LEAVE THROUGH THE PORTAL. BEFORE I GO, I WILL ANSWER THE REMAINING QUESTIONS AND LODGE MY TESTIMONY.”)
(GEROFF: “ARE YOU ASKING PERMISSION TO LEAVE, OR ASSURANCE THAT THE WORK WILL CONTINUE?”) (MIDORI: “THE SECOND. I KNOW YOU CANNOT PROMISE IT WILL BE EASY.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Orin opens the next day's agenda. It is long. Sela adds a pump replacement request; Hanae adds a medical shipment. Midori sees that they have plans for a day when her name does not appear in every solution.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Midori walks through Old Market with May Jin, Lian, and both children. His parents sit outside their temporary home nearby. The family is together; their housing and income remain practical concerns rather than magically repaired fortunes.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: A former neighbor still refuses May Jin's greeting. Lian takes his hand and continues walking. (MAY JIN: “THE REVIEW FINISHED ITS WORK. PEOPLE TAKE LONGER.”) (MIDORI: “DO YOU WISH YOU HAD REFUSED THE POSITION?”) Setting: He considers the question rather than answering for her comfort.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (MAY JIN: “I WISH MY FAMILY HAD NEVER NEEDED TO WONDER. I AM GLAD SOME MEN SURVIVED BECAUSE I TRANSLATED. I WANTED TO STOP BEING USEFUL TO AN ARMY AND START BEING PRESENT FOR THEM.”) Setting: He watches the children negotiate over a piece of fruit.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: At a standpipe, the motor changes pitch and an operator adjusts it without looking for Midori. (MIDORI: “I MAY GO BACK TO EARTH.”) Setting: May Jin stops beside her, saddened. (MAY JIN: “IS THAT WHAT YOU WANT?”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: May Jin offers to interpret during the final portal preparations if she wants him there. Lian supports the choice, with a request that he come home afterward. Midori bows to all of them. This is no first reunion; it is a farewell becoming possible.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Midori and Buren travel back to Zora with a returning official and relief party. The refitted balloon departs only after its qualified crew and wind mages have rested. Rest and weather stops are planned along the route. Narration: “AFTER PREPARATIONS FOR THE RETURN JOURNEY.”

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Inside the gondola, Midori helps secure a crate by hand. Geroff travels with the party to report and seek further authority; joint work in Nyas continues through the agreed delegation during his absence. M'ow Oh remains in supervised custody there.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The mountain crossing passes through changing light and a sheltered pause. Midori studies the mortal research notes. Her memories of Zorna's kindness sit uneasily beside the theory on the page. She does not resolve the contradiction by discarding either.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The Temple receives them after the journey. (SERAPHINE: “THE WOUNDED? THE RELIEF CREWS?”) Setting: Midori hands over their reports. Only after the immediate arrivals are settled does she embrace Midori.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: From a Temple window, Midori sees familiar roofs. She puts the inquiry copy and portal notes on the same desk. Neither belongs to a life she can simply leave unexamined.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: In the Temple garden, Midori speaks while Seraphine listens. (MIDORI: “SELA STOPPED US GIVING OUT POISONED WATER. HANAE SAVED BUREN. MAY JIN HAS FOUND HIS FAMILY. I COULD NOT HAVE DONE ANY OF THOSE THINGS ALONE.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Midori shows the evidence. (MIDORI: “THE RESEARCHERS THINK ZORNA AND NYSSARA WORKED TOGETHER. THEY CANNOT ESTABLISH WHY.”)
(SERAPHINE: “I CANNOT ANSWER A QUESTION BY INVOKING THE NAME OF THE PERSON BEING QUESTIONED.”) Setting: Seraphine gathers the records. (SERAPHINE: “WE MUST PRESERVE THESE AND EXAMINE THEM.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The conversation turns to the portal. Midori lays the portal assessment beside the evidence. (MIDORI: “THEY ARE HELPING ME GO HOME. I DID NOT THINK I COULD FORGIVE THEM. NOW I CANNOT KEEP SAYING 'THEM' AND MEAN EVERYONE.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (SERAPHINE: “HAS FORGIVING THEM MADE YOUR LOSSES SMALLER?”) Setting: Midori shakes her head.
(SERAPHINE: “THEN YOU NEED NOT PRETEND IT HAS. YOU CAN CHOOSE WHAT YOU WILL DO NEXT WITHOUT DECLARING THAT WHAT HAPPENED WAS ACCEPTABLE.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (MIDORI: “I WANT TO SEE THE SHRINE. THE ABBESS. BUT WANTING TO GO FEELS LIKE ABANDONING EVERYONE HERE.”) Setting: Seraphine puts down the research papers and takes her hand.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Seraphine and Midori sit together without an audience. (SERAPHINE: “IF YOU STAY, LET IT BE BECAUSE YOU CHOOSE THIS LIFE. IF YOU GO, LET IT BE BECAUSE YOU CHOOSE THAT JOURNEY. GUILT WILL FOLLOW EITHER ROAD IF YOU LET IT MAKE THE CHOICE.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (MIDORI: “THERE ARE PEOPLE IN NYAS WHO WILL ALWAYS HATE ME.”) (SERAPHINE: “PERHAPS. DEPARTURE WILL NOT ERASE YOUR RECORD. STAYING FOREVER WOULD NOT ERASE IT EITHER.”) Setting: The signed testimony remains visible beside Midori's folded travel clothes.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (MIDORI: “I MUST LEAVE ALL MY STORED MANA BEHIND BEFORE I CROSS.”) (SERAPHINE: “THEN THE DECISION MUST BELONG TO THE WOMAN WHO WALKS THROUGH, NOT TO THE POWER EVERYONE HAS LEARNED TO ASK FROM HER.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: They walk toward the practice court. A young acolyte struggles to lift a small stone and then succeeds. Midori laughs when the child celebrates too soon and drops it. Seraphine allows the ordinary moment to last.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Midori decides to visit her friends and memorials before returning to Nyas. She is not ordered to say goodbye. She chooses to make the visits because postponing them has become another way of refusing the decision.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Naandeen meets Midori at the Academy gate with books under her arm. Classes have resumed where circumstances allow. Workers finish repairs to a roof beside a notice listing an absent instructor; the notice uses established Zoran script.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (STUDENT: “THANK YOU, LADY MIDORI! WHAT IS NYAS LIKE NOW?”) (MIDORI: “THEY ARE REBUILDING. IT IS DIFFICULT. ENGINEERS, HEALERS, FAMILIES—PEOPLE FROM BOTH NATIONS ARE DOING THE WORK.”) Setting: The students listen around her.

fragments.text: Setting: Zorna glances toward Nyssara when the projection shows a family in Nyas. They recognize people whose fates appeared as outcomes in their records. Neither is allowed to halt the projection because it has become uncomfortable.

fragments.text: Setting: Alpha raises a hand. (ALPHA: “SUFFERING ALONE TEACHES NOTHING. IF WE REMOVE ALL AWARENESS, WE MAY PUNISH STRANGERS WHO NO LONGER UNDERSTAND THE JUDGMENT. IF WE PRESERVE THEIR AUTHORITY, WE LEAVE THE SAME TEMPTATION INTACT.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: He addresses the administrators. (ALPHA: “YOU KNEW THESE LIVES AS OBSERVERS. YOU WILL LIVE AMONG THE CONSEQUENCES AS PEOPLE WHO CANNOT EDIT THEM.”) Setting: The Council quiets to hear the proposal.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (ALPHA: “YOU WILL BE REINCARNATED INTO EXPERIMENTAL WORLD PAIR SEVEN AS MORTALS. YOU WILL RETAIN AWARENESS OF THESE EVENTS. YOU WILL POSSESS NO ADMINISTRATIVE AUTHORITY AND NO DIVINE POWER TO ALTER THE WORLD AROUND YOU.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (COUNCIL MEMBER: “WILL THEIR KNOWLEDGE GIVE THEM A WAY BACK TO CONTROL?”)
(ALPHA: “THEY RETAIN MEMORY, NOT ACCESS. NO OFFICE, AUTHORIZATION, OR DIVINE INTERVENTION FOLLOWS THEM. THEIR ACTIONS WILL HAVE MORTAL CONSEQUENCES.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (ZORNA: “CAN WE REPAIR WHAT WE HAVE DONE?”) (ALPHA: “AS MORTALS CAN. BY WORK, BY RELATIONSHIPS, BY ACCEPTING LIMITS. NOT BY REWRITING THE PEOPLE WHO REFUSE YOUR HELP.”) Setting: Nyssara lowers her eyes.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The seven ordinary Council members vote; Alpha presides without adding a routine vote. The proposal is adopted. The projection holds on the unchanged memorials and civilian claims records as the decision is entered.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The projection of Nyas persists beside the decision. A civilian operator changes a crystal while a Zoran keeper checks the coupling. Mortal cooperation has begun before divine punishment and will not depend on it for permission to continue.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Terra, in her canonical formal gown, stands near the established 1:00 position before Alpha. She occupies no Council seat and does not vote. (TERRA: “I ACCEPT RESPONSIBILITY FOR THE SUPERVISION I FAILED TO PROVIDE.”) Setting: The Council examines negligence separately from the administrators' deliberate violations rather than treating all three as interchangeable offenders.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (ALPHA: “YOU WERE ENTRUSTED WITH SUPERVISING TWO NEOPHYTE ADMINISTRATORS. REPEATED VIOLATIONS WENT UNRECOGNIZED. YOUR FAILURE WAS NOT THE SAME ACT. IT WAS CONSEQUENTIAL.”) Setting: Terra remains to hear the terms.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (ALPHA: “UNTIL THEY COMPLETE THEIR MORTAL LIVES, YOU ASSUME RESPONSIBILITY FOR EARTH AND EXPERIMENTAL WORLD PAIR SEVEN. OBSERVE. PROVIDE THE SUPERVISION YOU FAILED TO PROVIDE. YOU WILL NOT INTERFERE.”) Setting: Terra bows her head.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (TERRA: “I UNDERSTAND.”) Setting: Alpha orders the judgment carried out. White light gathers around Zorna and Nyssara. They look at one another with awareness that the next lives will not provide the offices from which they once corrected an inconvenient result.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The light fills the frame, then gives way to daylight on an ordinary shared street. The next sequence begins after a stated mortal interval, not at the instant of judgment.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Narration: “TEN MONS AFTER JUDGMENT.” Narration: “TWO AND A HALF YURS.” Setting: A broad view of Nyas shows repaired water routes, working workshops, and inhabited streets. The older damage has not vanished, but the city is no longer organized around emergency queues and gun positions.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: At River Gate, Sela supervises a mixed maintenance crew. A Zoran apprentice and a Nyssarian operator argue amiably over who last calibrated a coupler. They check the log and settle it. Their shared work no longer requires Midori standing beside the bank.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Hanae receives ordinary patients alongside continuing war care. A Zoran healer consults her about a difficult case. Families in the waiting area use both languages; the two practitioners exchange familiar greetings before examining the patient.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: At the civilian assembly office, Orin posts another public account. A repair claim remains contested, and a missing-person inquiry is still open. The peace has endured enough to make patient procedure possible; reconciliation has not required pretending every loss was repaired.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: A scheduled crystal shipment arrives under the continuing agreement. The delivery docket cites the ratified supply terms and bears the authorized civilian and Zoran signatures. These continuing shipments no longer rely on Geroff's original emergency mandate. People unload it as a delivery, not an invasion. The clerk checks the shipment against the continuing supply account.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: May Jin finishes a civilian translation assignment and puts away his papers at the agreed hour. He is paid for the work he chose; no Zoran military officer waits to reclaim his service. Lian meets him outside with both children.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: They visit his parents, now settled nearby. The older child corrects a younger sibling's Zoran phrase; the younger replies in Nyssarian. May Jin's father complains that neither child will let him finish a story. The family laughs without erasing what their separation cost.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: In another district, Zoran and Nyssarian households prepare a joint neighborhood celebration. Friends carry food across a threshold that once divided suspicious lodgings. Reconciliation appears in ordinary expectations of visiting, learning, trading, and caring for one another.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Midori's name appears in a preserved public account beside other names. (CHILD: “WHO WAS MIDORI?”) Setting: An adult points first to the waterworks and then to the war record, making room for both. Her absence has not required either worship or erasure.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Across the mountains in Zora, neighbors approach a home with gifts for an expected birth. A Zoran neighbor opens the household's handleless door with mana; it slides horizontally into the wall. The Nyssarian father welcomes the arriving Zoran and Nyssarian friends. Inside, his Zoran wife is attended by a midwife. Their marriage belongs to the shared life the two peoples have built.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (MOTHER: “LET ME SEE THEM. BOTH OF THEM.”) Setting: The Nyssarian father waits beside her, frightened until he hears them cry. (FATHER: “BOTH OF THEM?”) (MIDWIFE: “BOTH HEALTHY. COME CLOSER.”)

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The firstborn has black hair and elven ears. The younger has platinum-blonde hair and human ears. The mother smiles at each daughter; the father gently supports the blankets.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Outside the room, neighbors of both peoples lower their voices. Someone who has arrived with a practical gift is urged to stay for food. The birth takes place within an ordinary network of shared care, not a gathering imposed by divine instruction.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: (FATHER: “HAVE YOU DECIDED THEIR NAMES?”) Setting: The parents have chosen one associated with each people's divine tradition, now names their daughters can make their own. (MOTHER: “NYSSARA FOR THE FIRST. ZORNA FOR HER SISTER.”) Setting: She touches each blanket as she names the child.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The father repeats both names softly and kisses his wife's hand. Neither parent knows who the children were. The midwife places the girls close together where the mother can see them both.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Close on the older infant, Nyssara, settling as her parents speak. Her awareness cannot move a ledger, summon a servant, or change the room. She is held securely in an ordinary mortal mother's arms.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: The younger infant reaches out. Her small fingers close around her sister's heel. Nyssara pauses in her crying; the adults laugh softly at the contact. It is a baby's grasp, not a divine act.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Close on Zorna's open eyes. Her retained awareness briefly appears through the familiar mature Zorna image associated with her thought. (ZORNA (thinking): “I CAN'T BELIEVE ... I'M THE YOUNGER ONE.”) Setting: The thought belongs only to her, unheard by the parents.

source_scenes.definition: Stable source-scene anchor; may span two adjacent production panels after approved container distribution. Not a new dramatic sequence.

fragments.text: Setting: Final wide. The mixed family rests together while friends from both peoples wait beyond the open door. Outside, everyday life continues in a reconciled society whose future is made by its inhabitants. The two former administrators will grow up inside it, without power to rewrite it.
