blocks.text: Narration: “THE MORNING AFTER THE SURRENDER.”
blocks.tail_rule: Caption box; no tail

blocks.speaker: OFFICER
blocks.text: (OFFICER: “EASTERN ARTILLERY REFUSES TO SURRENDER ITS GUNS. TWO FRONTIER COMMANDS HAVE NOT ANSWERED.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: GEROFF
blocks.text: (GEROFF: “BRING ME THE ORIGINAL MESSAGE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “I COULD REACH THE BATTERIES BEFORE NOON.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: BUREN
blocks.text: (BUREN: “THEN SIT HERE UNTIL WE KNOW WHAT YOU WOULD FIND.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: GEROFF
blocks.text: (GEROFF: “ONE REFUSAL. TWO SILENCES. WE WILL NOT TURN THEM INTO THREE BATTLES.” -> “SEND MESSENGERS. BRING THE UNIT RECORDS AND OFFICERS WHO KNOW THESE COMMANDERS.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: M'OW OH
blocks.text: (M'OW OH: “BRING THE EASTERN COLONEL'S LAST ACKNOWLEDGMENT. HE ALWAYS CHANGES ONE WORD WHEN HE IS AFRAID.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: GEROFF
blocks.text: (GEROFF: “HE IS UNDER INVESTIGATION. HE IS ALSO THE MAN THOSE SOLDIERS RECOGNIZE. BOTH FACTS APPLY.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: M'OW OH
blocks.text: (M'OW OH: “HIS MEN HEARD THAT SURRENDER MEANS EXECUTION. HE HAS PUT THE GUNS ACROSS THE ROAD BECAUSE THEIR FAMILIES ARE BEHIND THEM.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: BUREN
blocks.text: (BUREN: “THAT DOES NOT MAKE THE ROAD HIS.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: M'OW OH
blocks.text: (M'OW OH: “NO. IT TELLS US WHAT HE MUST HEAR BEFORE HE OPENS IT.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: M'OW OH
blocks.text: (M'OW OH: “I SURRENDERED THE SEAL. THE WITNESSES CAN CONFIRM THAT THIS IS MY ORDER. I WILL NOT BORROW IT BACK IN SECRET.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “AND IF THEY FIRE?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: BUREN
blocks.text: (BUREN: “PROTECT THE PEOPLE. GIVE US TIME TO ANSWER.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: COMMANDER
blocks.text: (COMMANDER: “THEY WILL TAKE THE GUNS AND THEN TAKE US.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MAY JIN
blocks.text: (MAY JIN: “INSPECTION AND CUSTODY. NO PROMISE THAT EVERY OFFICER IS INNOCENT. NO PERMISSION TO PUNISH YOUR FAMILIES.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: WOMAN
blocks.text: (WOMAN: “CAN THE MEDICINE COME THROUGH NOW?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SERGEANT
blocks.text: (SERGEANT: “WE RECEIVED NO SURRENDER ORDER.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: ZORAN OFFICER
blocks.text: (ZORAN OFFICER: “YOU EXPECT US TO BELIEVE THAT?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: BUREN
blocks.text: (BUREN: “LET THE WIRE FINISH ITS TESTIMONY BEFORE YOU BEGIN YOURS.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “YESTERDAY I WOULD HAVE SEEN THE UNIFORMS FIRST.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: BUREN
blocks.text: (BUREN: “TOMORROW WE WILL HAVE TO REMEMBER WHAT WE LEARNED TODAY.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: GEROFF
blocks.text: (GEROFF: “ZORA REQUIRES DISARMAMENT, VERIFIED WITHDRAWAL, AND PROTECTION FOR THE RELIEF TEAMS.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: M'OW OH
blocks.text: (M'OW OH: “THEN ORDERS MUST COME THROUGH PEOPLE MY COUNTRY WILL HEAR. IF EVERY NOTICE BEARS ONLY YOUR SEAL, RESISTANCE WILL RECRUIT FROM THE WATER QUEUES.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: ORIN
blocks.text: (ORIN: “AND IF EVERY NOTICE BEARS ONLY YOURS, THOSE QUEUES WILL EXPECT ANOTHER REQUISITION FOR THE ARMY.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: M'OW OH
blocks.text: (M'OW OH: “THEN LET THEM SEE WHO AGREED, WHAT IT COSTS, AND WHO MAY CHALLENGE IT.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: GEROFF
blocks.text: (GEROFF: “I WILL IMPLEMENT ZORA'S REQUIREMENTS. M'OW OH WILL TRANSMIT THE COMPLIANCE ORDERS. THE ASSEMBLY WILL OVERSEE CIVILIAN ALLOCATIONS.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: M'OW OH
blocks.text: (M'OW OH: “RECORD OUR OBJECTIONS AS WELL AS OUR DECISIONS.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SELA
blocks.text: (SELA: “GOOD. WHICH OF THOSE CHAIRS CAN GET ME A REPLACEMENT?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: NYSSARIAN OFFICIAL
blocks.text: (NYSSARIAN OFFICIAL: “CAN THE ACCOUNT SAY SIMPLY THAT OUR NATIONS CHOSE PEACE?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: ZORAN RECORDER
blocks.text: (ZORAN RECORDER: “IT MUST ALSO RECORD THE SURRENDER.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: M'OW OH
blocks.text: (M'OW OH: “WRITE THAT WE SURRENDERED. WRITE WHY. I WILL NOT ASK YOU TO HIDE IT SO MY PORTRAIT CAN REMAIN ON A WALL.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: NYSSARIAN OFFICIAL
blocks.text: (NYSSARIAN OFFICIAL: “MUST OUR CHILDREN INHERIT THE DISGRACE?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: ORIN
blocks.text: (ORIN: “A CHILD'S NAME DOES NOT BELONG IN A COLUMN OF COMMAND RESPONSIBILITY. NEITHER DOES A COMMANDER'S NAME BELONG BEHIND THE WORD 'EVERYONE.'”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: GEROFF
blocks.text: (GEROFF: “KEEP THE ORIGINALS. PUBLISH BOTH LANGUAGES. WHERE ACCOUNTS CONFLICT, RECORD THE CONFLICT.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “I WAS AUTHORIZED TO STRIKE MILITARY INDUSTRY. I ATTACKED THE REFINERY AND GRID. THE SAME SYSTEMS SERVED THE HOUSES AND HOSPITALS.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: RECORDER
blocks.text: (RECORDER: “DID YOU KNOW PEOPLE LIVED BESIDE THE WORKS?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “I KNEW THERE WERE HOUSES. I DID NOT MAKE MYSELF THINK ABOUT WHO WAS INSIDE THEM.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “WHEN THEY TRIED TO TAKE RAUK, I RAISED A FIELD AROUND THEM. THE SHELTER ENTRANCE WAS INSIDE IT.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “I STOPPED IT. THAT DOES NOT MEAN I CONTROLLED IT FROM THE BEGINNING.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: ZORAN OBSERVER
blocks.text: (ZORAN OBSERVER: “YOU ARE GIVING THEM A WEAPON AGAINST HER.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: GEROFF
blocks.text: (GEROFF: “THEN WE HAD BETTER MAKE THE RECORD ACCURATE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: COUNCILOR
blocks.text: (COUNCILOR: “MY SON DIED TAKING A POSITION FROM THOSE PEOPLE. NOW WE ARE SUPPLYING IT.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: M'OW OH
blocks.text: (M'OW OH: “YOUR SON. WHAT WAS HIS NAME?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: GEROFF
blocks.text: (GEROFF: “THE CRYSTALS GO TO THE HOSPITAL UNDER JOINT CUSTODY. THE CONNECTIONS WILL BE INSPECTED.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: COUNCILOR
blocks.text: (COUNCILOR: “THEN I WANT TO SEE THOSE CONNECTIONS MYSELF.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: GEROFF
blocks.text: (GEROFF: “YOU SHALL.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: COUNCILOR
blocks.text: (COUNCILOR: “SEND THE HOSPITAL CRYSTALS. I WANT THE NEXT ACCOUNT AS WELL.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: WORKER
blocks.text: (WORKER: “THE HOSPITAL BANK IS RUNNING LOW. CAN YOU CHARGE THAT TOO?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “YES.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: VEY
blocks.text: (VEY: “HANAE. BEFORE WE CONNECT HER.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “I AM TIRED. I AM NOT EMPTY.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: HANAE
blocks.text: (HANAE: “THAT IS WHAT I AM CHECKING.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: HEALER
blocks.text: (HEALER: “YOUR RESERVE HAS FALLEN. THE AMOUNT STILL INSIDE YOU IS TOO MUCH TO KEEP SAFELY.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: HANAE
blocks.text: (HANAE: “NO MORE PRETENDING THAT HOLDING IT IS HARMLESS. WE NEED A CONTROLLED DISCHARGE BEFORE IT INJURES YOU.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “THEN FIND SOMETHING USEFUL TO PUT IT IN.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: WORKER
blocks.text: (WORKER: “THOSE ARE THE CRYSTALS THE PUMPS NEED.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: VEY
blocks.text: (VEY: “NEED DOES NOT MAKE A FRACTURED VESSEL SAFE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “IF I TELL YOU I CAN DO ANOTHER, CHECK BEFORE YOU BELIEVE ME.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SELA
blocks.text: (SELA: “I WAS GOING TO.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MESSENGER AT THE DOOR
blocks.text: (MESSENGER AT THE DOOR: “WHEN CAN SHE COME TO THE HOSPITAL?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SELA
blocks.text: (SELA: “THESE WILL GO THERE. SHE STAYS HERE UNTIL HANAE SAYS OTHERWISE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: VEY
blocks.text: (VEY: “YOUR CONDITION WAS ALWAYS PART OF THE SYSTEM. LEAVING IT OUT OF THE LEDGER DID NOT REMOVE IT.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: HANAE
blocks.text: (HANAE: “BELOW THE IMMEDIATE DANGER. YOU STILL CARRY MANA. WE ARE STOPPING HERE, NOT DECLARING YOU INEXHAUSTIBLE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: CLERK
blocks.text: (CLERK: “YOU ACCEPTED THEIR POSITION.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MAY JIN
blocks.text: (MAY JIN: “YES.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: REVIEWER
blocks.text: (REVIEWER: “WHAT DID YOU TRANSLATE? WHAT MILITARY INFORMATION DID YOU GIVE THEM? WHICH WORK DID YOU CHOOSE?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MAY JIN
blocks.text: (MAY JIN: “CHECK EACH ASSIGNMENT AGAINST THE ORIGINALS. HEAR THE PEOPLE WHO WERE THERE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: NEIGHBOR
blocks.text: (NEIGHBOR: “HE STILL WORKS FOR THEIR ARMY.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: LIAN
blocks.text: (LIAN: “WILL YOU RETURN TO THEIR CAMP EVERY EVENING? WHERE ARE WE SUPPOSED TO BELONG IN THAT LIFE?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: LIAN
blocks.text: (LIAN: “WE ARE HERE. THE MISSING ARE OURS. DECIDE WHERE YOU ARE TRYING TO COME HOME.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MAY JIN
blocks.text: (MAY JIN: “I ACCEPTED THE WORK. I AM ASKING TO END IT PROPERLY. I NEED TO FIND MY FAMILY AND LIVE HERE WITHOUT CARRYING YOUR ORDERS IN MY POCKET.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: COMMANDER
blocks.text: (COMMANDER: “WE STILL NEED INTERPRETERS.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MAY JIN
blocks.text: (MAY JIN: “I WILL FINISH THE HANDOVER AND TEACH THE REPLACEMENTS WHAT THEY NEED.” -> “BEING NEEDED CANNOT MEAN I NEVER GET TO LEAVE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: GEROFF
blocks.text: (GEROFF: “YOU MAY VOLUNTEER FOR CIVILIAN INTERPRETATION AFTERWARD. THAT WILL BE A NEW ARRANGEMENT. IT WILL NOT BE AN OBLIGATION HIDDEN INSIDE YOUR RELEASE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MAY JIN
blocks.text: (MAY JIN: “PUT THAT IN THE RELEASE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: GEROFF
blocks.text: (GEROFF: “INCLUDE IT.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: LIAN
blocks.text: (LIAN: “GOOD. NOW TELL ME WHAT THE RAILWAY OFFICE FOUND.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: ORIN
blocks.text: (ORIN: “WE FOLLOW THE ENTRIES SEPARATELY UNTIL THEY MEET. WE CANNOT FIND THEM BY MAKING THEM AGREE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.text: Narration: “OVER THE FOLLOWING DAYS.”
blocks.tail_rule: Caption box; no tail

blocks.speaker: MAY JIN
blocks.text: (MAY JIN: “LIAN AND THE LITTLE ONE ARE SAFE. WE HAVE A ROUTE TO FOLLOW FOR THE OLDER ONE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MAY JIN
blocks.text: (MAY JIN: “THEY BROUGHT THE MESSAGE THROUGH. I WILL EXPLAIN THE REST WHEN YOU ARE STRONG ENOUGH TO ARGUE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: OLDER CHILD
blocks.text: (OLDER CHILD: “WILL THEY TAKE US AWAY FROM EACH OTHER AGAIN?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: FATHER
blocks.text: (FATHER: “YOU TOOK A PLACE IN THEIR MILITARY?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MAY JIN
blocks.text: (MAY JIN: “AFTER CAPTURE AND PAROLE, YES. I CHOSE THE INTERPRETER'S WORK. I HAVE ASKED TO LEAVE IT. I AM COMPLETING THE HANDOVER.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MOTHER
blocks.text: (MOTHER: “CAN WE STAY TOGETHER NOW?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MAY JIN
blocks.text: (MAY JIN: “THE LODGING IS TEMPORARY. WE CAN APPLY TOGETHER. MY RELEASE IS DUE AFTER THE HANDOVER.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MAY JIN
blocks.text: (MAY JIN: “I AM GOING HOME.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: LIAN
blocks.text: (LIAN: “THEN WALK WITH US.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: VEY
blocks.text: (VEY: “WE HAVE PROVED THAT IT CAN WORK. WE HAVE NOT PROVED THAT THE NEXT WORKSHOP CAN MAKE ONE SAFELY.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SELA
blocks.text: (SELA: “THE CITY WILL NOT PROMISE TO DRAW THE SAME AMOUNT EVERY MOMENT. MAKE THE REGULATOR EXPECT OUR MISTAKES AS WELL AS OUR BEST DAY.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: BUREN
blocks.text: (BUREN: “CIVILIAN LOADS. JOINT ACCOUNTS. ENOUGH HELD BACK FOR THE RETURN JOURNEY.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: ZORAN OFFICIAL
blocks.text: (ZORAN OFFICIAL: “WHAT STOPS THESE CRYSTALS POWERING WEAPONS?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: VEY
blocks.text: (VEY: “RECORDED CIVILIAN INSTALLATIONS. ISOLATED CIRCUITS. INSPECTIONS YOU CAN ATTEND.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: FIRST DELEGATE
blocks.text: (FIRST DELEGATE: “WE WANT FEWER ZORAN GUARDS.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SECOND DELEGATE
blocks.text: (SECOND DELEGATE: “NOT UNTIL THE HARDLINERS ARE GONE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: COUNCILOR
blocks.text: (COUNCILOR: “THIS GRANTS THE HOSPITAL UNLIMITED REQUISITIONS.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: HANAE
blocks.text: (HANAE: “THEN LIMIT IT TO VERIFIED PATIENT NEED AND REQUIRE A PUBLIC ACCOUNT.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “WHO DECIDES IN AN EMERGENCY IF I AM NOT HERE?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: VEY
blocks.text: (VEY: “WE WILL DISAGREE. THEN THE PEOPLE WHOSE TURN IT IS WILL DECIDE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SELA
blocks.text: (SELA: “GO AND EAT. WE KNOW HOW TO CLOSE A VALVE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: GEROFF
blocks.text: (GEROFF: “CAN IT MOVE TROOPS?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: M'OW OH
blocks.text: (M'OW OH: “THE STAFF MUST KNOW THAT THE RESEARCH IS BEING EXAMINED, NOT CONFISCATED BY A RIVAL BUREAU.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “WHEN KESH OFFERED IT, I THOUGHT I WOULD OWE HER MY WAY HOME.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: VEY
blocks.text: (VEY: “SHE OFFERED SOMEONE ELSE'S WORK. LET US ASK THE PEOPLE WHO DID IT WHAT THEY ACTUALLY HAVE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SENIOR SCIENTIST
blocks.text: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “BEFORE ANYONE TOUCHES THAT SWITCH, I NEED TO KNOW WHO INTENDS TO LISTEN.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SENIOR SCIENTIST
blocks.text: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “IT FOLLOWS THE TRAVELER'S LINK TO THE WORLD OF ORIGIN. WE CANNOT CHOOSE A DESTINATION AND SEND AN ARMY THERE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: GEROFF
blocks.text: (GEROFF: “WHERE WOULD IT TAKE SOMEONE BORN HERE?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SENIOR SCIENTIST
blocks.text: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “OUR RESULTS GIVE US NO ROUTE OUT OF THIS WORLD FOR SOMEONE WHO ORIGINATES HERE. THE SAME LIMITATION APPLIES TO US. A DESTINATION DIAL WOULD BE MORE CONVENIENT. WE HAVE NEVER MADE ONE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “I WAS BORN ON EARTH.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SENIOR SCIENTIST
blocks.text: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “THEN YOU ARE THE CASE WE COULD NEVER INVESTIGATE. SOMEONE HERE WHOSE ORIGIN LIES ELSEWHERE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SENIOR SCIENTIST
blocks.text: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “MAY I MEASURE THE RESPONSE?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: GEROFF
blocks.text: (GEROFF: “THEN ZORA HAS NO USE FOR IT AS A PASSAGE. KEEP THE DANGEROUS EQUIPMENT SECURE. THE RESEARCH NEED NOT BECOME A TROPHY.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SENIOR SCIENTIST
blocks.text: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “ONE QUESTION AT A TIME. AND SHE MAY REFUSE EVERY ONE OF THEM.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “WHAT CAN YOU TELL ME ABOUT EARTH?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SENIOR SCIENTIST
blocks.text: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “YOUR ORIGIN MAY SUPPLY THE DESTINATION. THAT DOES NOT GIVE US AN ADDRESS, A DATE, OR PROOF OF SAFE ARRIVAL.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “AND IF I STAY HERE?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SENIOR SCIENTIST
blocks.text: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “THEN WE KEEP A QUESTION UNANSWERED. THAT HAS HAPPENED BEFORE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SENIOR SCIENTIST
blocks.text: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “WHAT DO YOU REMEMBER OF ARRIVING? THE JOURNEY, YOUR BODY, THE LANGUAGE?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “I CAN TELL YOU WHAT I EXPERIENCED. SOME OF THE EXPLANATION CAME FROM ZORNA. MARK THAT SEPARATELY.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “IF I SAY STOP, YOU STOP.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SENIOR SCIENTIST
blocks.text: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “YES.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “I MET ZORNA IN THE DOTG. I SPOKE WITH HER THERE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: RESEARCHER
blocks.text: (RESEARCHER: “WE THOUGHT THIS KNOWLEDGE HAD ONE SOURCE. YOUR ACCOUNT LEAVES US WITH ANOTHER SOURCE ACTING ON THE SAME HISTORY.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “I REMEMBER ROSELYN, AND A HISTORY IN WHICH SHE WAS NEVER BORN. I REMEMBER ASHIRE ALIVE, AND DEAD FOR YURS BEFORE I ARRIVED.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MAY JIN
blocks.text: (MAY JIN: “DOES ANYONE ELSE REMEMBER BOTH?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “NOT AS I DO. DO NOT PUT WORDS IN THEIR MOUTHS BECAUSE I REMEMBER THEM.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “YOU HAVE BEEN TRYING TO EXPLAIN THIS TOO.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SENIOR SCIENTIST
blocks.text: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “FOR LONGER THAN WE UNDERSTOOD WHAT THE QUESTION WAS.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: FIRST RESEARCHER
blocks.text: (FIRST RESEARCHER: “THEY MAY HAVE WORKED TOGETHER.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SECOND RESEARCHER
blocks.text: (SECOND RESEARCHER: “BUT THEIR ACTIONS OPPOSED EACH OTHER.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: RESEARCHER
blocks.text: (RESEARCHER: “OPPOSING MOVES DO NOT PROVE SEPARATE PURPOSES. WE CANNOT ESTABLISH THE PURPOSE FROM THE MOVES ALONE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “YOU THINK THEY MAY HAVE WORKED TOGETHER. ON US.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SENIOR SCIENTIST
blocks.text: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “THAT IS OUR THEORY. NOT PROOF OF WHAT THEY WANTED.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MAY JIN
blocks.text: (MAY JIN: “DOES THAT CHANGE WHAT THE TARGETING LOGS SAY?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “NO. IT DOES NOT MAKE MY CHOICES SOMEONE ELSE'S. IT DOES MEAN WE SHOULD STOP ACCEPTING EVERY DIVINE EXPLANATION WITHOUT QUESTIONS.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “MAY I TAKE COPIES TO SERAPHINE?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “THE PEOPLE WORKING ON THIS HELPED MAKE THOSE REGULATORS TOO.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SENIOR SCIENTIST
blocks.text: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “YOU MIGHT ACTUALLY REACH IT.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SENIOR SCIENTIST
blocks.text: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “MIGHT. WE HAVE NOT SENT YOU.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “WHAT DO YOU WANT IN EXCHANGE?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SENIOR SCIENTIST
blocks.text: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “YOUR PERMISSION TO LEARN. YOUR HONEST ANSWERS. IF YOU CHOOSE TO CROSS, YOUR INFORMED AGREEMENT. NOT A PARDON FOR THE GOVERNMENT.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “THE PEOPLE I WANTED TO DESTROY ARE TRYING TO GIVE ME A ROAD HOME.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SELA
blocks.text: (SELA: “SOME OF US ARE. YOU ARE ALLOWED TO KNOW WHICH PEOPLE YOU ARE SPEAKING TO.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SENIOR SCIENTIST
blocks.text: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “A STORED MANA LOAD WOULD ENTER THE TRANSFER WITH YOU. WE CANNOT PERMIT THAT. BEFORE YOU STEP THROUGH, YOU MUST DISCHARGE ALL OF IT. ALL, MIDORI. NOT MERELY ENOUGH TO BRING YOU BELOW RED.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “THEN HOW DO YOU POWER IT?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: VEY
blocks.text: (VEY: “YOU CHARGE THE PORTAL'S ISOLATED SUPPLY BEFORE CROSSING. IT OPERATES FROM THAT STORE AFTER WE DISCONNECT YOU. THE POWER FOR THE MACHINE DOES NOT TRAVEL INSIDE YOU.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “SOME TO OPEN THE WAY. THE REST STAYS HERE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SENIOR SCIENTIST
blocks.text: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “AND NONE CROSSES INSIDE YOU.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “WHAT WILL EMPTY FEEL LIKE?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: ZORAN HEALER
blocks.text: (ZORAN HEALER: “THIS IS HER STORED MANA. THIS IS HER LIVING BODY. WE MUST EMPTY ONE WITHOUT HARMING THE OTHER.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: HANAE
blocks.text: (HANAE: “WE STOP IF THE PROCEDURE HARMS YOU. WE ALSO STOP THE CROSSING IF YOU STILL HOLD A RESERVE. THE SCHEDULE DOES NOT OUTRANK EITHER CONDITION.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “COULD I HEAL MYSELF AFTERWARD?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: ZORAN HEALER
blocks.text: (ZORAN HEALER: “YOU WILL HAVE NO STORED MANA TO USE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “NO SHIELD. NO HEALING. NO FLIGHT.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: HANAE
blocks.text: (HANAE: “THEN DRINK THIS BEFORE IT BECOMES ANOTHER THING YOU MEAN TO DO WITH MAGIC.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “IF I CHANGE MY MIND AFTER THE DISCHARGE?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: SENIOR SCIENTIST
blocks.text: (SENIOR SCIENTIST: “YOU REMAIN HERE WITHOUT THAT STORED RESERVE. THE CITY KEEPS ITS POWER. YOUR PERMISSION IS NOT A SWITCH THAT LOCKS BEHIND YOU.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: GEROFF
blocks.text: (GEROFF: “THE LONGER-TERM PROPOSALS HAVE GONE TO THE COUNCIL FOR RATIFICATION. RELIEF AND SURRENDER COMPLIANCE CONTINUE UNDER OUR PRESENT MANDATE.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “I MAY LEAVE THROUGH THE PORTAL. BEFORE I GO, I WILL ANSWER THE REMAINING QUESTIONS AND LODGE MY TESTIMONY.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: GEROFF
blocks.text: (GEROFF: “ARE YOU ASKING PERMISSION TO LEAVE, OR ASSURANCE THAT THE WORK WILL CONTINUE?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “THE SECOND. I KNOW YOU CANNOT PROMISE IT WILL BE EASY.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MAY JIN
blocks.text: (MAY JIN: “THE REVIEW FINISHED ITS WORK. PEOPLE TAKE LONGER.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “DO YOU WISH YOU HAD REFUSED THE POSITION?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MAY JIN
blocks.text: (MAY JIN: “I WISH MY FAMILY HAD NEVER NEEDED TO WONDER. I AM GLAD SOME MEN SURVIVED BECAUSE I TRANSLATED. I WANTED TO STOP BEING USEFUL TO AN ARMY AND START BEING PRESENT FOR THEM.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MIDORI
blocks.text: (MIDORI: “I MAY GO BACK TO EARTH.”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.speaker: MAY JIN
blocks.text: (MAY JIN: “IS THAT WHAT YOU WANT?”)
blocks.tail_rule: One tail to this block owner only

blocks.text: Narration: “AFTER PREPARATIONS FOR THE RETURN JOURNEY.”
blocks.tail_rule: Caption box; no tail

blocks.speaker: SERAPHINE
blocks.text: (SERAPHINE: “THE WOUNDED? THE RELIEF CREWS?”)

source_paragraphs: IAKESI Chapter 20
The War Is Over, the Reckoning Remains
Layout Locked Master v2.0.17
56 locked story pages and 308 panels

Chapter 20 follows the eight-day crisis and formal surrender in Chapter 19. Geroff and M’ow Oh implement the transition while recovery, accountability, and civilian cooperation make Midori’s departure possible. Each speech block names its owner. Setting text is unlettered; speech, thoughts, and narration use ALL CAPS.
Continuity and reading notes

Chapter 19 v2.6 supplies the starting state. May Jin’s parents and older child are missing at the opening; his Zoran military service, civilian review, family search, and release are developed here. M’ow Oh remains under supervised custody while contributing to the transition.

Midori’s finite reserve includes her earlier mana and absorbed energy from two blasts. Her reserve has fallen since Chapter 19, but the remaining stored load is still biologically unsafe at the red-eye warning. The warning occurs before the next charging session; it does not represent newly acquired mana. The existing ledger governs remaining reserve and safe output; transfer efficiency is not numerically fixed.

The initial controlled discharge relieves red-zone biological danger. The later final discharge empties every stored mana reserve before crossing: the tested portal allocation powers an isolated external store, and the remaining mana is conditioned into the city’s reserve crystals. Transfer losses do not become usable power. No internal reserve or charged item crosses with Midori.

The portal is useful as an off-world passage only to Midori. Its origin-based research gives no ordinary Zoran or Nyssarian transit benefit. Her Earth arrival is reserved for a later story; no arrival scene appears here.
Ten mons after judgment means two and a half yurs. The final sequence shows sustained reconciliation, including a mixed household and the twins’ birth.

Comic-story page and panel identities below are locked at Step 17. Setting text is unlettered. Parenthesized speech has one named or role-identified owner; a connected speech chain has one tail. Thoughts use (thinking) with one thought-dot trail. Narration appears in caption boxes. Diegetic writing follows the established fictional scripts. Story content remains frozen after Step 9. The 56-page, 308-panel layout is locked after Step 17; later structural changes require documented regression and renewed layout approval.
Page 01  The First Morning Without War

PANEL 1. Setting: Dawn over Nyas. The balloon rests at the western aerodrome. At River Gate, Sela watches a clean, restricted stream enter the Low Basin main. Beside the distribution queue, yesterday's surrender notice curls in the damp. Narration: “THE MORNING AFTER THE SURRENDER.”

PANEL 2. Setting: Inside the signal room, Orin pins acknowledgments beside a map. Several districts remain blank. A Zoran officer reads a message aloud. (OFFICER: “EASTERN ARTILLERY REFUSES TO SURRENDER ITS GUNS. TWO FRONTIER COMMANDS HAVE NOT ANSWERED.”) (GEROFF: “BRING ME THE ORIGINAL MESSAGE.”)

PANEL 3. Setting: Midori stands by the window. Beyond her, a stretcher passes the water queue. (MIDORI: “I COULD REACH THE BATTERIES BEFORE NOON.”) Setting: Buren, his injured arm still supported, sets a chair beside the map. (BUREN: “THEN SIT HERE UNTIL WE KNOW WHAT YOU WOULD FIND.”)

PANEL 4. Setting: Geroff separates the reports. (GEROFF: “ONE REFUSAL. TWO SILENCES. WE WILL NOT TURN THEM INTO THREE BATTLES.” -> “SEND MESSENGERS. BRING THE UNIT RECORDS AND OFFICERS WHO KNOW THESE COMMANDERS.”) Setting: Midori sits, reluctantly.

PANEL 5. Setting: In a guarded room nearby, M'ow Oh hears the request. He looks at the empty place where his command seal once lay. (M'OW OH: “BRING THE EASTERN COLONEL'S LAST ACKNOWLEDGMENT. HE ALWAYS CHANGES ONE WORD WHEN HE IS AFRAID.”)
Page 02  Whose Voice Counts

PANEL 1. Setting: M'ow Oh enters the signal room under escort. A Zoran officer moves to exclude him from the map. Geroff stops the officer. (GEROFF: “HE IS UNDER INVESTIGATION. HE IS ALSO THE MAN THOSE SOLDIERS RECOGNIZE. BOTH FACTS APPLY.”)
PANEL 2. Setting: M'ow Oh reads the artillery message. (M'OW OH: “HIS MEN HEARD THAT SURRENDER MEANS EXECUTION. HE HAS PUT THE GUNS ACROSS THE ROAD BECAUSE THEIR FAMILIES ARE BEHIND THEM.”)
PANEL 3. (BUREN: “THAT DOES NOT MAKE THE ROAD HIS.”) (M'OW OH: “NO. IT TELLS US WHAT HE MUST HEAR BEFORE HE OPENS IT.”)

PANEL 4. Setting: May Jin prepares parallel texts: Zoran geometric glyphs run left to right; Nyssarian engineered pictographs run top to bottom in columns ordered right to left. Each uses its own numeral symbols. Geroff specifies the Zoran requirements: cease fire, admit a witnessed inspection, secure ammunition, and leave the relief route open. M'ow Oh records the order in his own voice, including the old unit-response phrase.

PANEL 5. Setting: A Nyssarian liaison questions the unsealed order. M'ow Oh points to the custody entry. (M'OW OH: “I SURRENDERED THE SEAL. THE WITNESSES CAN CONFIRM THAT THIS IS MY ORDER. I WILL NOT BORROW IT BACK IN SECRET.”)

PANEL 6. Setting: Midori volunteers to accompany the messengers. Geroff allows her to escort the relief convoy, not to lead the negotiation. (MIDORI: “AND IF THEY FIRE?”) (BUREN: “PROTECT THE PEOPLE. GIVE US TIME TO ANSWER.”) Setting: She repeats the instruction before leaving.
Page 03  The Battery On The Road

PANEL 1. Setting: The convoy reaches the eastern road. Nyssarian guns overlook the approach; families shelter behind the emplacement. Midori walks beside a cart marked for medical relief in the established world script. Buren accompanies the convoy in a relief cart, his injured arm supported. She keeps her hands visible and her protective shield close.

PANEL 2. Setting: The battery commander refuses to leave cover. (COMMANDER: “THEY WILL TAKE THE GUNS AND THEN TAKE US.”) Setting: May Jin reads the guarantees and their limits. (MAY JIN: “INSPECTION AND CUSTODY. NO PROMISE THAT EVERY OFFICER IS INNOCENT. NO PERMISSION TO PUNISH YOUR FAMILIES.”)

PANEL 4. (ALPHA: “AN UNAUTHORIZED CONTACT MAY BEGIN AS A LAPSE. THIS REQUIRED REPETITION. IT REQUIRED DECISIONS TO CONTINUE.”) Setting: The investigators identify a second authorization pattern within the same experimental history.
PANEL 5. Setting: The two traces are separated. One belongs to Zorna. The other is labeled Nyssara. The Council watches the records line up beneath both names.
Page 48  What The Mortals Could Not Prove

PANEL 1. Setting: The investigators reconstruct the connected interventions of Zorna and Nyssara. Actions that appeared opposed within mortal history belong to a shared involvement in the same experiment. The reconstruction identifies alterations of already lived mortal history as well as the separately recorded direct contacts. The evidence establishes cooperation beyond the mortals' hypothesis.

PANEL 2. (INVESTIGATOR: “THEY WORKED TOGETHER WHILE PRESENTING THEIR ACTIONS THROUGH DIFFERENT DIVINE INTERESTS. THE INHABITANTS COULD OBSERVE THE CONSEQUENCES. THEY COULD NOT EXAMINE THIS RECORD.”) Setting: The report does not claim that every mortal act was commanded by a god.
PANEL 3. Setting: Alpha studies the decisions after each intervention. (ALPHA: “AND THE PEOPLE STILL CHOSE.”)

PANEL 4. (INVESTIGATOR: “YES. UNDER CONDITIONS REPEATEDLY ALTERED WITHOUT AUTHORIZATION.”) Setting: Responsibility for creating those conditions and responsibility for acting within them remain distinct.

PANEL 5. Setting: The projection briefly holds on the Nyas inquiry: M'ow Oh testifying, Midori signing, civilians giving evidence. Those proceedings are not dissolved because a higher level of misconduct has been found.

PANEL 6. (ALPHA: “SUMMON ZORNA AND NYSSARA. INCLUDE THE SUPERVISORY RECORD.”) Setting: An official goes to find Terra. The projection remains open, keeping the human consequences in the room awaiting judgment.
Page 49  Before The Council

PANEL 1. Setting: Zorna and Nyssara, in their canonical formal gowns, stand at the established 11:00 position before the Council. The reconstructed record appears behind them. Their administrative signatures are identified. Nyssara starts to turn toward Zorna, then faces the entries bearing her own signature. Neither can treat the other's participation as a complete defense of her own.
PANEL 2. (ALPHA: “YOU MAY ANSWER THE EVIDENCE.”) (ZORNA: “I CHOSE THE OUTCOMES I WANTED. I STOPPED OBSERVING.”)
PANEL 3. (NYSSARA: “WE KEPT INTERVENING TO CONTINUE THE EXPERIMENT.”) Setting: Their signatures remain visible behind them.

PANEL 4. (ALPHA: “YOU COULD ALTER CIRCUMSTANCES. THE PEOPLE INSIDE THEM COULD NOT APPEAL TO THIS ROOM. YOU MADE THEIR LIVES ANSWER QUESTIONS THEY HAD NEVER AGREED TO BE ASKED.”) Setting: The projection rests on a water queue, not on a diagram of competing nations.
PANEL 5. (COUNCIL MEMBER: “WOULD THE WAR HAVE HAPPENED WITHOUT THEM?”)
PANEL 6. (INVESTIGATOR: “WE CANNOT ESTABLISH AN UNTOUCHED HISTORY WITH CERTAINTY. WE CAN ESTABLISH THEIR REPEATED ALTERATIONS AND CONTINUED INTERVENTION IN THIS ONE.”)

PANEL 7. (ALPHA: “THE FIRST LAW WAS KNOWINGLY VIOLATED. RESPONSIBILITY FOR THOSE VIOLATIONS IS ESTABLISHED. WE WILL DETERMINE JUDGMENT.”) Setting: Zorna and Nyssara stand beneath the evidence of choices they can no longer revise.
Page 50  What Punishment Can Do
PANEL 1. (FIRST COUNCIL MEMBER: “REMOVE THEIR RANK. EXCLUDE THEM FROM DIVINE SERVICE.”) (SECOND COUNCIL MEMBER: “REINCARNATE THEM. LET THEM SUFFER AS THOSE PEOPLE SUFFERED.”)
PANEL 2. (THIRD COUNCIL MEMBER: “WHAT LIFE WOULD ANOTHER INJURY RESTORE?”)

PANEL 3. (COUNCIL MEMBER: “WITHOUT POWER. WITHOUT AUTHORITY. LET THEM BE UNABLE TO SOLVE EVERY CONSEQUENCE BY CHANGING THE RULES.”) Setting: A second member proposes removal of memory. The question of awareness divides the table.

PANEL 4. Setting: Zorna glances toward Nyssara when the projection shows a family in Nyas. They recognize people whose fates appeared as outcomes in their records. Neither is allowed to halt the projection because it has become uncomfortable.

PANEL 5. Setting: Alpha raises a hand. (ALPHA: “SUFFERING ALONE TEACHES NOTHING. IF WE REMOVE ALL AWARENESS, WE MAY PUNISH STRANGERS WHO NO LONGER UNDERSTAND THE JUDGMENT. IF WE PRESERVE THEIR AUTHORITY, WE LEAVE THE SAME TEMPTATION INTACT.”)

PANEL 6. Setting: He addresses the administrators. (ALPHA: “YOU KNEW THESE LIVES AS OBSERVERS. YOU WILL LIVE AMONG THE CONSEQUENCES AS PEOPLE WHO CANNOT EDIT THEM.”) Setting: The Council quiets to hear the proposal.
Page 51  The Lives They Cannot Edit

PANEL 1. (ALPHA: “YOU WILL BE REINCARNATED INTO EXPERIMENTAL WORLD PAIR SEVEN AS MORTALS. YOU WILL RETAIN AWARENESS OF THESE EVENTS. YOU WILL POSSESS NO ADMINISTRATIVE AUTHORITY AND NO DIVINE POWER TO ALTER THE WORLD AROUND YOU.”)
PANEL 2. (COUNCIL MEMBER: “WILL THEIR KNOWLEDGE GIVE THEM A WAY BACK TO CONTROL?”)
PANEL 3. (ALPHA: “THEY RETAIN MEMORY, NOT ACCESS. NO OFFICE, AUTHORIZATION, OR DIVINE INTERVENTION FOLLOWS THEM. THEIR ACTIONS WILL HAVE MORTAL CONSEQUENCES.”)

PANEL 4. (ZORNA: “CAN WE REPAIR WHAT WE HAVE DONE?”) (ALPHA: “AS MORTALS CAN. BY WORK, BY RELATIONSHIPS, BY ACCEPTING LIMITS. NOT BY REWRITING THE PEOPLE WHO REFUSE YOUR HELP.”) Setting: Nyssara lowers her eyes.

PANEL 5. Setting: The seven ordinary Council members vote; Alpha presides without adding a routine vote. The proposal is adopted. The projection holds on the unchanged memorials and civilian claims records as the decision is entered.

PANEL 6. Setting: The projection of Nyas persists beside the decision. A civilian operator changes a crystal while a Zoran keeper checks the coupling. Mortal cooperation has begun before divine punishment and will not depend on it for permission to continue.
Page 52  Terra And The Light

PANEL 1. Setting: Terra, in her canonical formal gown, stands near the established 1:00 position before Alpha. She occupies no Council seat and does not vote. (TERRA: “I ACCEPT RESPONSIBILITY FOR THE SUPERVISION I FAILED TO PROVIDE.”) Setting: The Council examines negligence separately from the administrators' deliberate violations rather than treating all three as interchangeable offenders.

PANEL 2. (ALPHA: “YOU WERE ENTRUSTED WITH SUPERVISING TWO NEOPHYTE ADMINISTRATORS. REPEATED VIOLATIONS WENT UNRECOGNIZED. YOUR FAILURE WAS NOT THE SAME ACT. IT WAS CONSEQUENTIAL.”) Setting: Terra remains to hear the terms.

PANEL 3. (ALPHA: “UNTIL THEY COMPLETE THEIR MORTAL LIVES, YOU ASSUME RESPONSIBILITY FOR EARTH AND EXPERIMENTAL WORLD PAIR SEVEN. OBSERVE. PROVIDE THE SUPERVISION YOU FAILED TO PROVIDE. YOU WILL NOT INTERFERE.”) Setting: Terra bows her head.

PANEL 4. (TERRA: “I UNDERSTAND.”) Setting: Alpha orders the judgment carried out. White light gathers around Zorna and Nyssara. They look at one another with awareness that the next lives will not provide the offices from which they once corrected an inconvenient result.
PANEL 5. Setting: The light fills the frame, then gives way to daylight on an ordinary shared street. The next sequence begins after a stated mortal interval, not at the instant of judgment.
Page 53  Ten Mons Later

PANEL 1. Narration: “TEN MONS AFTER JUDGMENT.” Narration: “TWO AND A HALF YURS.” Setting: A broad view of Nyas shows repaired water routes, working workshops, and inhabited streets. The older damage has not vanished, but the city is no longer organized around emergency queues and gun positions.

PANEL 2. Setting: At River Gate, Sela supervises a mixed maintenance crew. A Zoran apprentice and a Nyssarian operator argue amiably over who last calibrated a coupler. They check the log and settle it. Their shared work no longer requires Midori standing beside the bank.

PANEL 3. Setting: Hanae receives ordinary patients alongside continuing war care. A Zoran healer consults her about a difficult case. Families in the waiting area use both languages; the two practitioners exchange familiar greetings before examining the patient.

PANEL 4. Setting: At the civilian assembly office, Orin posts another public account. A repair claim remains contested, and a missing-person inquiry is still open. The peace has endured enough to make patient procedure possible; reconciliation has not required pretending every loss was repaired.

PANEL 5. Setting: A scheduled crystal shipment arrives under the continuing agreement. The delivery docket cites the ratified supply terms and bears the authorized civilian and Zoran signatures. These continuing shipments no longer rely on Geroff's original emergency mandate. People unload it as a delivery, not an invasion. The clerk checks the shipment against the continuing supply account.
Page 54  A Shared Street

PANEL 1. Setting: May Jin finishes a civilian translation assignment and puts away his papers at the agreed hour. He is paid for the work he chose; no Zoran military officer waits to reclaim his service. Lian meets him outside with both children.

PANEL 2. Setting: They visit his parents, now settled nearby. The older child corrects a younger sibling's Zoran phrase; the younger replies in Nyssarian. May Jin's father complains that neither child will let him finish a story. The family laughs without erasing what their separation cost.

PANEL 3. Setting: In another district, Zoran and Nyssarian households prepare a joint neighborhood celebration. Friends carry food across a threshold that once divided suspicious lodgings. Reconciliation appears in ordinary expectations of visiting, learning, trading, and caring for one another.

PANEL 4. Setting: Midori's name appears in a preserved public account beside other names. (CHILD: “WHO WAS MIDORI?”) Setting: An adult points first to the waterworks and then to the war record, making room for both. Her absence has not required either worship or erasure.
Page 55  The Two Daughters

PANEL 1. Setting: Across the mountains in Zora, neighbors approach a home with gifts for an expected birth. A Zoran neighbor opens the household's handleless door with mana; it slides horizontally into the wall. The Nyssarian father welcomes the arriving Zoran and Nyssarian friends. Inside, his Zoran wife is attended by a midwife. Their marriage belongs to the shared life the two peoples have built.

PANEL 2. (MOTHER: “LET ME SEE THEM. BOTH OF THEM.”) Setting: The Nyssarian father waits beside her, frightened until he hears them cry. (FATHER: “BOTH OF THEM?”) (MIDWIFE: “BOTH HEALTHY. COME CLOSER.”)
PANEL 3. Setting: The firstborn has black hair and elven ears. The younger has platinum-blonde hair and human ears. The mother smiles at each daughter; the father gently supports the blankets.

PANEL 4. Setting: Outside the room, neighbors of both peoples lower their voices. Someone who has arrived with a practical gift is urged to stay for food. The birth takes place within an ordinary network of shared care, not a gathering imposed by divine instruction.
Page 56  The Younger One

PANEL 1. (FATHER: “HAVE YOU DECIDED THEIR NAMES?”) Setting: The parents have chosen one associated with each people's divine tradition, now names their daughters can make their own. (MOTHER: “NYSSARA FOR THE FIRST. ZORNA FOR HER SISTER.”) Setting: She touches each blanket as she names the child.

PANEL 2. Setting: The father repeats both names softly and kisses his wife's hand. Neither parent knows who the children were. The midwife places the girls close together where the mother can see them both.

PANEL 3. Setting: Close on the older infant, Nyssara, settling as her parents speak. Her awareness cannot move a ledger, summon a servant, or change the room. She is held securely in an ordinary mortal mother's arms.

PANEL 4. Setting: The younger infant reaches out. Her small fingers close around her sister's heel. Nyssara pauses in her crying; the adults laugh softly at the contact. It is a baby's grasp, not a divine act.

PANEL 5. Setting: Close on Zorna's open eyes. Her retained awareness briefly appears through the familiar mature Zorna image associated with her thought. (ZORNA (thinking): “I CAN'T BELIEVE ... I'M THE YOUNGER ONE.”) Setting: The thought belongs only to her, unheard by the parents.

PANEL 6. Setting: Final wide. The mixed family rests together while friends from both peoples wait beyond the open door. Outside, everyday life continues in a reconciled society whose future is made by its inhabitants. The two former administrators will grow up inside it, without power to rewrite it.

states: Separate flowers and remembered deaths. Adnil’s instantaneous death is not retold as a lingering farewell; Marta intercepted bullet after protection was abandoned.
Mortal claims/memorials remain real despite divine misconduct finding.
MEMORIALS.render_limit: No apparition, answering voice, resurrection or invented Marta grave site.

TRAVEL_CARRIER.identity: Refitted Nyssarian Tech-Mech carrier balloon with large delegation gondola.
states: At western aerodrome in Nyas source geography.
Rested qualified crew and wind mages, hand-secured cargo, mountain route and sheltered stop.
Return to Nyas follows crewed route and planned stops; no teleport.
TRAVEL_CARRIER.render_limit: Do not substitute small Zoran observation balloon, modern aircraft or Midori-powered solo flight.

DIVINE_DISPLAYS.identity: Administrative record displays and Council’s synchronized magical views, distinct from WOA station.
states: Red alarm crystal; event administrative trace enters Council jurisdiction, passenger heads Earth.
Main magical display above/behind Alpha; smaller synchronized one before him.
Only recorded images rewind. DOTG room time continues forward; evidence attached before conclusions.
Signatures/records stay as hearing context; no divine finding erases mortal inquiry.
DIVINE_DISPLAYS.render_limit: No mechanical monitor support, WOA compass/floor substitution, Soul Relocation gates or unapproved interfaces.

FAMILY_RECORDS.identity: Separate older-child wagon route and grandparents’ clinic lead, later release/housing documents.
states: Wife/younger child known present; other three missing. Never combine contradictory leads merely from hope.
Identify parents at clinic and child at evacuation station before full reunion.
Civilian findings and military/parole closure follow handover; housing remains provisional.
Family together in chosen civilian life; parents nearby, both children retained.
FAMILY_RECORDS.render_limit: No magical rescue instantaneously finding everyone or automatic universal trust.

continuity_clarifications.resolution: White light closes divine sequence. Explicit ten-mons/2.5-yur caption starts later society; newborns appear in Zora after this interval, not during judgment or as older children. Keep names behind final turn.

continuity_clarifications.issue: Page-level context could automatically populate every official in the final portal room.

P16 parents are May Jin’s parents; P55-56 parents are the twins’ parents. Generic Council voices come from canonical seated members, never additional voters.
